hook.text_role: stops a stranger with a simple question
hook.visual: handheld street shot, interviewer mic in frame, lower-third question

beats.visual: stranger answers on camera, interviewer off-frame
interviewer hands over the product, stranger tries it
product held to camera by the stranger, end card
beats.line_role: a person's last line, not a slogan: the brief's offer, else the product plus one dry line; never 'today', never the hook again

rules: roles and patterns only - no original lines, footage, audio or likeness
